data.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Pricing
data.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🏅 The Role:

Rosso is tem's core IP, the transaction infrastructure that prices electricity for thousands of businesses, balances portfolios in real time, and sits on the critical path for every deal tem closes. Machine learning is at the heart of Rosso, combining forecasting, optimisation and classical ML to process billions of data points and drive thousands of automated decisions a day. Every inference shapes the prices our customers see, so you can immediately see the impact of your work.

We have proved the concept with MVPs and POCs to grow to 2% of the UK market. Now we want to take it to the next level and build towards a state of the art solution, to fuel our expansion in the UK and take Rosso international.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead pricing ML within Rosso, building a platform that proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time. Your primary focus will be the pricing engine, which sets the fees added to every quote tem serves, carefully balancing growth and margin. You will also contribute to the systems which manage both short and long-term imbalance decisions to determine how tem deals with its exposure across its portfolio.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. You own the technical direction of pricing by building it: most of your week is writing and shipping production code. It is not a people leadership role, and not an architecture role where others do the implementing.

The right person is energised by the greenfield environment: comfortable taking on ambiguity and able to make progress before the path is fully defined. They have built pricing, trading or optimisation systems that worked, ideally in energy or another market-driven domain, and have learned from the times they haven't. They'll bring that hard-won judgment to a system where the foundations are still being laid, and where early decisions compound. Success will be turning our current reactive system into a pricing engine which proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time.

🚀 Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical direction for pricing ML: Define what to build and how within the pricing engine, setting the strategy and roadmap for pricing machine learning as a core piece of tem's IP.

  • Build ML systems for price optimisation: Design and implement models that dynamically set prices, balancing the trade-off between signing probability, portfolio balance and margin maximisation.

  • Solve imbalance problems: Develop probabilistic models to optimise risk management and short-term balancing decisions in a highly dynamic environment.

  • Bridge modelling and production: Own the modelling and data layer while working closely with software engineers and MLOps to ensure models are architected for production, contributing to system design decisions that affect performance and reliability.

  • Communicate pricing decisions clearly: Articulate model behaviour, assumptions, and trade-offs to other technical stakeholders so that pricing decisions are understood across the teams that depend on them.

🎯 Requirements:

Must-haves:

  • Deep experience building ML systems for pricing, revenue optimisation, or decision-making under uncertainty, with a track record of models that went from concept to production and delivered measurable commercial impact.

  • A quantitative background in a domain where prices, forecasts and risk interact: energy markets, power trading, batteries and flexibility, market making, or similar. Energy is strongly preferred and where our strongest fits have come from.

  • Strong foundation in stochastic optimisation and probabilistic modelling, with the judgement to formulate ambiguous business problems as the right mathematical approach rather than reaching for familiar tools.

  • Proven first-principles reasoning: you choose between stochastic programming, classical ML, reinforcement learning, or a simple heuristic based on the problem, not the technique you know best.

  • The engineering craft to match your modelling depth: production-grade Python, a high bar for code quality and system design, and the ability to work alongside software engineers as a technical peer across the full ML lifecycle.

  • Breadth across the full lifecycle: you carry the modelling and quant work and the productionising (deploying, monitoring, reasoning about the software systems around your models), and you would rather ship the whole thing to a good standard and iterate than perfect one component. You reason at the level of the outcome, the portfolio and its levers, not a single model.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or causal inference in applied, commercial settings.

  • PhD or equivalent research depth in a quantitative discipline (statistics, applied mathematics, physics, operations research, or similar).

  • Ability to reason about the trade-offs between optimisation solvers (Gurobi etc) and gradient-based ML methods (PyTorch etc), and the judgement to know when to reach for each.

  • Experience working with high data throughput systems in production.

About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build secure, reliable, and scalable systems as Maze grows.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack, but you should be excited to learn, move quickly, and make an impact.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has experience building and operating production systems in a modern cloud environment, ideally AWS

You don’t need experience with every technology in our stack. We care more about strong fundamentals, an ability to learn quickly, and excitement about helping us build reliable and secure systems as Maze scales.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

Nylon builds AI research tools that are changing how lawyers and accountants work. 2,000+ firms across New Zealand, Australia and the UK trust our platform, from the biggest firms in the world to small specialist practices.

Our go-to-market team runs on data. The quality of our outreach lists, the accuracy of our CRM and the reliability of the systems that connect them decide how well our sales and marketing efforts perform. We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own that data layer.

The role

You'll build and maintain the pipelines that find, enrich and deliver prospect data to our sales team, keep the CRM clean and trustworthy, and connect the tools in our stack so information flows without manual effort. It's a hands-on technical role at the intersection of sales operations, data and automation. Not a sales role, and not a pure engineering role. You'll report to our Head of Go-to-Market, work closely with our account executives, SDRs and marketing, and have a lot of freedom in how you solve problems.

What you'll be doing

Outreach data and list building

  • Building targeted prospect lists across NZ, AU and the UK from the ideal customer profiles the GTM team defines, covering firm type, size, practice area, location and seniority

  • Sourcing data from multiple channels, including scraping public sources, enrichment platforms (Clay, Apollo or similar), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, professional body registers and our own product and website data

  • Designing waterfall enrichment flows that verify contact details, fill gaps and score leads, keeping bounce and unsubscribe rates low

  • Using AI tooling to research accounts at scale, qualify fit, personalise outreach inputs and automate the repetitive parts of list building

  • Maintaining data quality, deduplication and consent standards so lists arrive usable and compliant with the Privacy Act, Australian Privacy Principles and UK GDPR/PECR

CRM and integrations

  • Owning the health of our CRM (Attio), including object and field design, pipeline stages, data hygiene, deduplication, ownership rules and reporting views

  • Building and maintaining integrations between the CRM and the rest of the GTM stack, including our dialler (JustCall), scheduling (Calendly), billing (Stripe), analytics (Metabase and our product database) and marketing channels (Meta Ads, website forms)

  • Writing automations and scripts (Python or JavaScript, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n or direct API work) so leads, activities and revenue events land in the right place without anyone re-keying them

  • Querying our data warehouse and Metabase in SQL to report on pipeline, conversion, attribution and rep activity, and to reconcile CRM records against source-of-truth systems

  • Documenting how the stack fits together and training the team on the parts they touch

About you

  • 3 to 5 years in revenue operations, sales operations, growth engineering, data or a similar role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

  • Proven experience building outreach or prospect lists with scraping and enrichment tools such as Clay

  • Strong CRM administration on at least one modern platform (Attio, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), including data model design and hygiene rather than just day-to-day use

  • Solid SQL and comfort in a BI tool such as Metabase

  • Working proficiency in Python or JavaScript, plus experience with REST APIs, webhooks and automation platforms

  • Practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling in real workflows, with a clear view of where they help and where they don't

  • A high bar for data quality and the discipline to keep systems tidy over time

  • Clear written communication, translating what sales and marketing need into systems that deliver it

  • Experience with accounting or legal firms, or professional body datasets in NZ, AU or the UK, is an advantage

  • Familiarity with marketing attribution and multi-touch pipeline analysis is an advantage

  • The right to work in the UK

What you'll get

  • No legacy stack to work around and no committee to get through. If you can show a better way of finding customers or running the CRM, you'll ship it

  • A small, well-funded team where the systems you build directly determine how well the company grows

How to apply

Alongside your CV, include a short note about one data or automation problem you've solved for a sales team and how you did it. Links to anything you've built (repos, Clay tables, dashboards, write-ups) are welcome.

At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Your experience. Your ambition. Your next chapter.

Your career has been built around people, recognising potential, developing talent, building relationships and helping organisations succeed.

But what if your next chapter took you in a completely different direction?

We’re looking to connect with you as an ambitious, independent-minded Recruitment, HR or Talent Acquisition professional, ready to explore something beyond the conventional corporate career path.

More autonomy. Greater flexibility. Continued personal growth.

If you’re someone who enjoys a challenge, thinks independently and believes there’s always another level to reach, we’d love to hear from you.

About Us

We operate within the global personal development and leadership education sector, working with established programmes, structured digital systems and an international and intentional community of growth-minded professionals.

Our focus is on empowering individuals to develop their potential while creating an environment that encourages independence, leadership and continuous growth.

Your Role

Connect & Engage by building relationships with professionals interested in personal growth, leadership and exploring new possibilities.

Recognise Potential and use your people skills to identify individuals who may be aligned with our programmes and professional development pathways.

Expand Your Reach by applying established digital marketing strategies to connect with a wider audience.

Lead & Inspire others - taking your leadership ambitions to develop and support others as part of a growing international network.

Keep Growing by engaging in ongoing personal development, business education and leadership training.

Are You Someone Who...

  • Thrives on independence and enjoys taking ownership of your results?

  • Has spent years helping other people succeed and is ready to invest in your own growth?

  • Is ambitious, commercially minded and open to learning new skills?

  • Values flexibility but has the self-discipline to manage your own time?

  • Enjoys connecting with people and building meaningful relationships?

  • Believes another exciting professional chapter could still be ahead of you?

If that sounds like you, we may have something worth exploring.


Our Ideal Candidate Has

Professional Experience: Five or more years in HR, Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, People & Culture, Leadership or a related field.

Strong Communication: The ability to engage confidently and build genuine rapport with people from different backgrounds.

A Growth Mindset: A genuine interest in personal development, learning and continuous improvement.


What We Offer

Use Established Systems: Access structured digital marketing processes, resources and training.

Work Your Way: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote, self-directed working arrangement - on your terms.

Ongoing Development: Benefit from personal development, leadership education and mentorship.

International Community: Connect with like-minded professionals who value growth, independence and achievement.

Additional Benefits & Perks:

  • Fully flexible hours.

  • Choose your own location - remote.

  • Comprehensive training and ongoing support - at your own pace.

  • Work with and benefit from award-winning e-learning.

  • Travel opportunities.

This is a self-directed, independent contractor arrangement, not a traditional salaried employment position.

Compensation is a generous commission-based structure and dependent on individual performance - your results reflect your efforts. Earnings are not guaranteed.

The arrangement is best suited to motivated individuals who understand the responsibilities of working with full autonomy and are prepared to invest consistent effort in their development.

Ready for your Next Chapter?

Your next chapter could look very different from your last.

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

Are you passionate about hospitality and eager to make a real difference for hoteliers? At RoomPriceGenie, we're on a mission to help hotels boost revenue and simplify their operations. Our young, dynamic team is spread across Europe, with offices in Mannheim, Germany, and Steinhausen, Switzerland—and we're looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative to join us in driving growth and innovation!

In this role, you'll be the first point of contact for potential clients, sparking interest in RoomPriceGenie and connecting qualified property owners with our Sales Managers for product demos. You’ll play a key role in expanding our reach and will have the opportunity to contribute to our fast-growing startup’s success.

What You'll Do:

  • Engage with prospects: Identify decision-makers, uncover key business challenges, and pitch RoomPriceGenie’s solutions to ignite interest.

  • Daily outreach: Make and track phone calls through Hubspot, connecting with new prospects and keeping track of your success.

  • Bring your insights: Use your local market knowledge to enhance our outbound marketing activities and connect with hotel owners in a meaningful way.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends: Keep up-to-date on the latest hospitality industry news, trends, and competitor offerings to add value in your conversations.

  • Collaborate with management: Help streamline and optimize the customer journey, bringing fresh ideas to make processes smoother and more efficient.

  • Shape the future: Influence how our young startup develops by trying out your own approaches and contributing innovative ideas.

Your Profile

  • Native English speaker with excellent communication skills.

  • Currently based in United Kingdom or in CET timezone.

  • Sales-driven with a natural aptitude for understanding customer needs.

  • Tech-savvy and excited by the latest technology trends.

  • Positive and outgoing: You’re empathetic, enthusiastic, and love connecting with people.

  • Active listener: You know how to uncover pain points and find meaningful ways to engage with prospects.

  • Organized and detail-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can juggle multiple tasks with ease.

  • Team player: Success is sweeter when it’s achieved together, and you love contributing to team goals.

Nice to have

  • Additional European languages (Italian, French, or more!).

  • Experience in a SaaS or travel-tech company.

  • Hospitality industry experience or a passion for helping hotels.

  • Ability to work from our offices on a regular basis.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

The Role

We're hiring our founding London-based Product Specialist to sit at the heart of customer support and product quality. You’ll respond to live support requests, investigate bugs in real time, and work closely with engineering and product to ensure issues are resolved quickly and clearly. You’ll play a key role in keeping our customers unblocked, and helping our team stay fast, focused, and close to user pain.

You'll define what great support looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company becoming a category leader. The foundation is already in place: customers love the product, relationships are strong, and commercial results speak for themselves. Your opportunity is to scale that into a world-class CS organization alongside a low-ego, collaborative team, working directly with a VP of Customer Success who previously built leading CS organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.


You Will

  • Respond to incoming support tickets and product questions (Pylon, Slack, email)

  • Investigate live issues, replicate bugs, and gather technical details

  • Create well-scoped bug reports with context, repro steps, and priority guidance

  • Partner with engineering and product to coordinate resolution and track progress

  • Follow up with users once fixes or workarounds are in place

  • Maintain clean documentation, internal tools, and support workflows (Linear, Notion, etc.)

  • Spot recurring themes in feedback and flag insights to product leadership

You Have

  • Have 2–4+ years of experience in support engineering, product ops, customer success, customer experience or customer support at a SaaS company

  • Are a clear and calm communicator, with high empathy especially when customers are blocked

  • Are curious and scrappy -- you dig into bugs, run tests, and clarify edge cases

  • Works well with fast context switching and works with speed and multi-threaded

  • Can balance fast response times with thoughtful root cause analysis

  • Are organized, proactive, and comfortable coordinating across functions

  • Are based in London or open to relocating (in-office 5 days/week)

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience in AI, SaaS, or recruiting tech

  • Technical / product manager background

  • Experience with tools like Pylon, Paraform, Linear, Notion, HubSpot, or PostHog

  • Ability to write internal documentation, create bug tickets, or support triage automation

  • Experience at early stage startup and thrives in fast paced, scrappy, ambiguous environments

Location: In or willing to relocate to London (in-person 5 days a week)

Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees

  • Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

  • Daily meals provided: breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

For US Employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

  • $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • $300/month commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

For UK Employees:

  • Comprehensive private medical insurance with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.

  • £1,500 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being

  • £3,500/year commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

data.description:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it.

You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed.

  • You build genuinely good interfaces, and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires.

  • You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship.

  • Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build.

  • You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs.

Signals we like, none of them required:

founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

data.description:
About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry

  • Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:

    • Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,

    • Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and

    • Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence

… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited

  • Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios

  • Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven

  • Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)

  • Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals

  • Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence

The Skills and Experience You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field

  • 3-5 years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)

  • Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel – enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams

  • Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts

  • Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders

  • Experience working in and leading project teams

  • Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment

  • Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce

  • Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner

The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop

  • Experience with analytics and risk modeling

  • Experience in a SaaS product development environment

  • Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis

  • Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure

  • Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely

  • Opportunity to participate in a secondment program

  • Company-supported mentorship program

  • Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture

US specific

  • Competitive salary and unlimited PTO

  • Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Monthly catered lunches and happy hours

  • Company-paid learning and development assistance

  • Dependant care assistance plan

UK specific

  • Competitive salary, pension and benefits

  • Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage

  • Extra vacation days during winter holidays

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

Research shows the best candidates rarely match a job description point for point. If you're excited about this role and believe you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't line up perfectly with everything listed above.

CyberCube Analytics, Inc. and CyberCube Analytics Europe Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t tolerate discrimination against age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, race, color, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, veteran status, protected genetic information or political affiliation.

data.title: Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce
data.description:
Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players

Maneuver Marketing

Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products.

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs.

These results caught the attention of The Financial Times, as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore.

This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth!

Your Next Role

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability.

You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps.

Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance.

This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising.

What You’ll Do

1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands

  • Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales.

  • Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand.

  • Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media.

  • Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign.

  • Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance.

  • Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive.

  • Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation.

2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team

  • The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates.

  • Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows.

  • Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently.

3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline

  • Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list.

  • Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop.

  • Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends.

  • Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified.

  • Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees.

4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

  • Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance.

  • Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense.

  • Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate.

  • Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them.

  • Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance.

5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships

  • Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review.

  • Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback.

  • Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners.

  • Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications.

  • Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic.

  • Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly.

6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets

  • Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively.

  • Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content.

  • Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use.

  • Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels.

  • Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content.

  • Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role.

7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence

  • Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house.

  • Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume.

  • Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time.

  • Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly.

  • Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate.

7. Measure and Improve Performance

  • You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic.

  • You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns.

  • Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program.

  • Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment.

  • Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership.

  • Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format.

  • Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches.

How You’ll Succeed

  • You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution.

  • You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve.

  • You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content.

  • You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment.

  • You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone.

  • You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce.

  • You introduce structure without slowing down execution.

  • You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns.

  • You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align.

  • You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability.

  • Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for.

  • DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category.

  • Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it.

  • Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house.

  • Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships.

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them.

  • Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved.

Strongly preferred

  • Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound.

  • Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta.

  • Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time.

  • Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent.

  • Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories.

  • Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners.

  • Understanding of paid social creative testing and direct-response fundamentals.

  • Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture.

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

As a Senior Product Designer in Airalo’s User Experience division, you will shape consumer product experiences across native mobile and web for millions of people around the world. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on leading design from problem framing through delivery, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the Airalo Product Design Guild - our community for craft, critique, design systems, research-led decision-making, accessibility, experimentation, AI, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Lead end-to-end product design for Airalo’s consumer mobile and web experiences, from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, Growth, and other designers to translate customer needs, insights, and strategy into high-quality product improvements.
  • Create user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, UX copy, and production-ready specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and stakeholder conversations that create alignment and momentum.
  • Contribute to Airalo’s Design System, improving consistency, accessibility, quality, and efficiency across products.
  • Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, critique, and shared practice.
  • Help strengthen the Product Design Guild by raising the bar for craft, collaboration, research-led decision-making, and thoughtful use of AI.

    • Must-haves:
  • 6+ years or similar of dedicated experience in product design at a tech startup, scale-up, product-led company, or product-focused agency.
  • A strong portfolio showing high-quality UI, thoughtful interaction design, strong product thinking, and measurable impact.
  • Extensive experience designing, testing, and shipping native mobile and web applications for B2C products.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous design problems from discovery through delivery, balancing user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and product strategy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain design rationale clearly to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Figma and FigJam skills, with experience creating flows, prototypes, product specifications, and production-ready design assets.
  • Advanced experience working with design systems, native mobile guidelines, responsive design, accessibility, and product quality across mobile and web.
  • Advanced experience with motion, prototyping, or interaction details that bring product experiences to life.
  • Experience working in Lean and/or Agile product development environments, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Data, and Growth.
  • Able to facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and alignment conversations.
  • Experience using AI and emerging tools to improve the design workflow beyond simple prototyping.

    • Good to have:
  • Experience in telecommunications, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or global consumer products.
  • Knowledge of eSIMs, GSMA-related technologies, or mobile connectivity services.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Research, Data, Growth, or Content Design teams.

    • You should apply if…
  • You lead through craft, clarity, and systems thinking. You can turn complex problems into simple, well-crafted experiences while considering journeys, patterns, accessibility, content, edge cases, and scale.
  • You can own ambiguous problems. You do not need every answer before you start. You ask good questions, define the path forward, make smart trade-offs, and keep momentum without waiting to be told what to do.
  • You care about outcomes, not just output. You use research, data, customer feedback, and product strategy to make decisions that improve the user experience and support business goals.
  • You communicate with confidence and humility. You can explain design decisions clearly to designers, engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders without becoming defensive.
  • You raise the bar for the design community. You give thoughtful feedback, invite critique early, mentor others, and contribute to a Product Design Guild where designers learn and improve together.
  • You are curious about AI and new ways of working. You actively explore how AI and emerging tools can improve design workflows, speed up learning, and help teams make better decisions.

    • This isn't for you if…
  • You only want to design screens. This role requires shaping problems, influencing direction, collaborating across disciplines, and staying involved from discovery through delivery.
  • You need certainty or close direction to make progress. Senior designers at Airalo are expected to move through ambiguity, create momentum, and make thoughtful decisions independently.
  • You avoid feedback or critique. Our design culture depends on sharing unfinished work, challenging ideas respectfully, and changing direction when the evidence points elsewhere.
  • You optimize for perfection over impact. We care deeply about quality, but we also need to make pragmatic decisions, learn quickly, and ship improvements.
  • You are not interested in customers or the community. Speaking to customers, learning from them, and contributing to the Product Design Guild are central to how we build better products.

    • Why People Join Us

    🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

    For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

    🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

    Before You Hit Apply

    By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

data.title: Strategic Account Executive, EMEA (100% hunting role)
data.description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.

We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to accelerate Sonatype's growth across one of the most commercially significant and competitive enterprise technology markets.

This is a pure new-logo acquisition role for an accomplished enterprise hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, displacing established competitors and winning complex, high-value enterprise business.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.


Our role in detail:

Territory Development & Strategic New-Logo Acquisition:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise territory strategy across prospect accounts.

  • Take full accountability for new-logo acquisition, building and converting a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.

  • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

  • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

  • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

  • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

  • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

    • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

    Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

    We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

    You will be expected to:

    • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

    • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

    • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

    • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

    • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

    • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

    • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

    • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

    • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

      • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

      Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

      This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

      You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

      You will:
